notFound: Herschel Supply Co.: Mexico store (herschel.com.mx) lists products per colour under Spanish titles; only items whose titles matched the US model got an MX offer. Golf, snow, surf travel bags and kids/diaper bags were left out. Several suitcases publish internal dimensions only, so outsideCm is null for those. Warranty is 'Limited Lifetime', so warrantyYears is null.

Victorinox: there is no Irish storefront (no en-IE locale), so no IE offers. Connex is not in the en-GB sitemap. Spectra 3.0, original Airox, Crosslight Global/Frequent Flyer and Mythic Global appear only in the UK/MX sitemaps. Architecture Urban2 Weekender was out of stock in every market checked and is left out. Mythic Weekender has a lifetime warranty, so warrantyYears is null.

SwissGear: about 55 luggage listings on swissgear.com show 'Price Unavailable' or sold out (numbered retailer models such as 6262, 7811, 8836, 6110 and the new Sion II), so they are not listed as current. All sets and bundles are left out. No SwissGear storefront was found for UK, IE or MX.

Wenger: swissgear.com's Wenger range is laptop bags and business cases only. wenger.ch sells luggage in CHF to Switzerland only. UK data came from the retailer bags.co.uk (secondhand). Capacity is published only as litre ranges, so liters is null. No US, CA, IE or MX Wenger luggage source was verified.
Heys: the UK is served by eu.heys.com in EUR, not GBP, so there are no UK offers. No Mexican store was found. Kids luggage and sets are left out. Some CA-only and EU-only listings have no spec text.

Hartmann: shop.hartmann.com blocks automated reads with a PerimeterX captcha (HTTP 307) for both curl and WebFetch. US data came from Luggage Pros (secondhand). Colours the retailer marks discontinued were dropped. No UK, IE, CA or MX source was found.

Bric's: bricsmilano.com prices in EUR and ships to IE and GB. These are recorded as IE offers only, because there is no GBP price list. bricsus.com is a parked domain, and no CA or MX store was found. 10 more in-stock travel items fell beyond the 100-product cap. Capacity in litres is not published.

Kipling: kipling.com's regional sites (UK, IE, CA, MX) return Akamai 'Access Denied', so only US offers (us.kipling.com) are recorded. Rolling school backpacks and the Storia kids rolling bags are left out. The Darcey Small Carry-On page gave no specs.

Vera Bradley: Canada is served through international.verabradley.com (Global-e) and was not read, so the data is US only. Per-pattern listings are grouped into one model each. Sets, totes and charms are left out. Material varies by pattern, so it is null.

Rockland: rocklandluggage.com redirects to foxluggage.com, a Wix catalogue with no prices or cart. Walmart, Kohl's, Home Depot and Macy's block automated reads (captcha or 403). Data came from Luggage Factory, a US Shopify reseller (secondhand). Its prices look marketplace-derived and vary widely by colour, and it publishes no reliable specs, so dimensions, weight and capacity are null. Sets and Rockland Jr. kids items are left out.
